sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith - Model 870 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. Right on time, as always. I've got a job for you. A fellow stopped by not long ago with a lightning bolt symbol tattooed across his face. Nervous type, kept looking over his shoulder. At first I thought he was bringing trouble to my doorstep, but it turned out to be nothing. That's just... the way he is. He asked me to modify a Remington Model 870 with a laser device, a Magpul MOE handguard, and a tactical foregrip. It needs ergonomics at or above 60 and combined recoil below 500. He practically begged me to hurry, said someone was after him. Think you can handle it?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify a Remington Model 870 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- Unlocks purchase of Tromix Monster Claw 12ga muzzle brake at Mechanic LL3
- Unlocks purchase of Kalashnikov AK-104 7.62x39 assault rifle (variant RPKT mod.1) at Ref LL2
"Turned out to be a fine shotgun. I'll pass it along to the client. Here's your payment. He paid in advance."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
M870 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 500 or less recoil
- 60 or more ergonomics
- Any tactical device (such as the NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser)
- Any foregrip
- M870 Magpul MOE handguard

sections.heading: Builds
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard M870 from Skier LL1.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
